title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: show HDMI content on both room displays
notes: claim 52: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, dual-display settings and product licensing statements are supported. The feature-specific controls and default remain undocumented; the impact rationale understates who may notice the change, and the prerequisite control has an unnecessary applicability caveat.
